scope: Image service rejections for this project; ordinary art corrections are separate
unreliable_time: Use a new verified lower bound; never infer that the cooldown has elapsed
missing_original_prompt_or_input: Needs evidence; do not invent a substitute request
second_rejection: Wait at least another eight hours; retry unchanged only if still allowed and fewer than eight source retries have been consumed
eighth_retry_rejected: Keep blocked; no further automatic retry
